additional_info.subject: 0466038 - ID0466038-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312571675/06] Charging Issue CRM:00472000479
additional_info.body:
Hello Florent,
Unfortunately I can't access the logs from that session on ecog anymore.
During the  parameter discovery phase we receive the charging parameters from the EV but also the confirmation to proceed to the next phase (Cable Check).
See the example:
Most probably we didn't receive this EVReady in the expected time frame and the session was terminated. But the outlet seams to be working fine.
The isolation drop that you see in the logs is normal, the isolation monitor device (IMD) is reading and reporting the resistance values. It's normal to see it oscilante, what cannot happen is to measure values under the alarm set-point. When detects a value bellow stops the session.
Let me know if the information provided is clear and if I can proceed to close this ticket.
With best regards,
